newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends steady v dlr after late dollar rally.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends steady v dlr after late dollar rally.

text.p: Hungary's forint finished little changed against the dollar on Thursday, losing early gains after the dollar rebounded on better-than-expected US trade data.
The forint finished right on the central bank (NBH) bid at 161.15/20, compared to an opening of 161.10/20, dealers said.

"The 20-pip distance from the bid was maintained this morning in two-way business as buyers matched sellers," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank. "However forex buyers disappeared in the afternoon, bringing the forint back to the NBH bid."
Butor said at one point the forint strengthened to below 161.00 to the dollar but then fell back as the dollar surged.
Heavy turnover continued on the currency futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange. The yen was the most popular, although most currencies featured in total trade of 10.8 billion forints.
The dollar and sterling mostly rose, the Ecu, lira and Swiss franc mostly fell, while the mark and yen were mixed
